headline: Maker of Clear Eyes Recalls Nearly 40,000 Bottles Over Contamination Risk
context: Federal safety regulators said the maker of Clear Eyes Maximum Itchy Eye Relief voluntarily recalled the drops because of a “lack of assurance of sterility.”

sources.name: The New York Times
